description: This is a Java interface for managing permissions in a user management system, defining methods for retrieving, saving, updating, deleting, and filtering permissions.

classes.name: PermissionService
classes.description: A Java interface that extends a generic service for handling permission entities, providing methods to retrieve, list, save, delete, and filter permissions by various criteria.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieve a list of permissions by name.

methods.name: listPermission
methods.description: Retrieve a list of all permissions, possibly throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieve a permission by its unique identifier.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Save a new permission or update an existing one.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Retrieve permissions associated with a list of group IDs.

methods.name: listByCriteria
methods.description: List permissions based on specified filtering criteria.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Remove a permission from a specific group.
